open import AgdaDojang.Debug

  where

  monolith-below-member : IsMonolith 𝑨 μ → Nonzero 𝑨 (⋂ 𝑨 θ) → (i : I) → μ ⊆ θ i
  monolith-below-member mono nz i = {!!}
